# SpringCollider

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringCollider")`

A ball or a capsule tied to a joint, which the `SpringBone`s of the same `MeshPart` cannot pass through: a spine, a thigh, a head (ADR 0194). A few are enough -- a cape needs one for the back and one for each leg.

It collides with nothing else. It is not a physics shape, nothing in the world touches it, and like the chains it keeps out of the body it is picture only.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `JointName` | `string` | — | read/write | The joint it follows, as the file names it. A name the rig does not have follows the mesh part itself. |
| `Length` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far the capsule reaches along the joint's own up, from `Offset`. 0 is a ball. |
| `Offset` | `vector` | — | read/write | Where its centre -- or the capsule's lower end -- is, in the joint's own space. |
| `Radius` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | The radius of the ball, or of the capsule's ends. |
